summary.text: Michael Feggans is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 97th District, which covers part of the city of Virginia Beach, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Feggans sits on the House committees on Labor and Commerce, Public Safety and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Michael Feggans was born in Alexandria, Louisiana, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Feggans's education as Park University (B.S. of Healthcare Administration, 2010); Virginia Tech (Graduate Certificate in Information, Policy, and Society, 2014); Norfolk State University (M.S. of Science, Cyber Security, 2019).
The profile gives Feggans's occupation as cyber security entrepreneur.
The profile lists Feggans's military service as United States Air Force (2001-2021).
Feggans's listed memberships and affiliations include Air and Space Forces Association, Veteran of Foreign Wars, Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity Incorporated, American Legion.
